notes: All 35 printed asks are retained in 27 separately marked tasks. Q1(a,b,c), Q2(a)(i,ii), Q6(a–e) and Q7(a)(i,ii) each share one published scale.

Foundation Phase 3 uses its own award ladders: 25D [0,15,19,22,25], 15D [0,7,10,13,15], 10D [0,5,8,9,10], 20C [0,12,18,20]. No task in this paper is starred, so no additional full-credit-minus-one control is enabled.
Q3(b,c), Q6, Q7(a)(i,ii,iii), Q7(b)(iii) and Q8(c,d,g) retain candidate-follow-through notes. Q6 graph readings allow ±0·2; Q7(b)(iii) ±10 000; Q8(c,d) ±1 with intermediate partial-credit tolerances.
Q7(b)(ii) grants full credit when all points are correct but not joined. Q8(e) slope and intercept remain one 10B award, and Q8(g) rate and fixed fee one 5B award.
Every shared stem, original table, graph and model remains attached. The Q7(b)(iv) model is the published graphical estimate 14:34, preserved with its original graph.
